fit_reason: Whole 1977 Corvette coupe listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Black paint looks dusty and slightly dull on the hood and front fenders, with uneven reflections under overcast light
Dust and road film along the lower rocker area and front bumper
Driver seat outer bolster vinyl looks worn and flaking along the lower edge
Water bottle left in the passenger seat and a loose mat on the driver floor
Light dust on the red carpet and center console area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the black 1977 Corvette. The paint on the hood and fenders looks a little dusty and dull in the photos, and the red interior could use a freshen up before buyers see it. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a wash, buff and wax plus interior cleaning, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
